hypotheses.T1_raw4_is_cross_corpus_natural_bottlene: Raw weight outliers capture at least 75% as much centered-write variance as the corpus-optimal rank-four space on every corpus.
hypotheses.T2_raw4_alone_is_behaviorally_sufficient: Keeping only the post-bias mean plus raw outlier-4 component gives median final-distribution KL at most 0.02 on every corpus.
hypotheses.T3_raw4_plus_tail16_is_near_sufficient: Keeping raw outlier-4 plus the frozen FineWeb residual-tail 16-space gives median KL at most 0.02 on every corpus.
hypotheses.T4_raw4_plus_tail64_is_high_fidelity: Keeping raw outlier-4 plus the frozen FineWeb residual-tail 64-space gives median KL at most 0.005 on every corpus.
hypotheses.T5_tail16_is_stable_and_compact: The frozen FineWeb tail-16 space has mean canonical cosine at least 0.70 and at least 75% of optimal tail-16 variance on every corpus.
hypotheses.T6_learned_tail_beats_random_tail: Raw outlier-4 plus learned tail-16 gives at most half the median KL of raw outlier-4 plus a matched random residual 16-space on every corpus.
hypotheses.T7_weight_anchored_program_beats_unconst: Raw outlier-4 plus tail-16 gives no more median KL than the unconstrained natural rank-20 PCA space on every corpus.
hypotheses.T8_full_projection_is_identity: Full output-space retention changes the final distribution by median KL at most 1e-7 on every corpus.
